Aircal now operates
170 nonstop Tlignts
each business day
between the Bay Area
and Southern California,
including departures
every hour between

San Francisco Inter-
national airports.
And, with AirCal,
you get more than fre-
quent flights. You also
get superior service. It starts with single-call reser-
vations service and pre-reserved seating, and con-
tinues with convenient one-stop check-in at the airport.
On board, there's our famous Executive Class Service
with extra legroom for each passenger.
So, when looking for an airline to fly between
the Bay Area and
Southern California,
remember the air-
line that offers you
frequent flights
HOLLYWOOD
